text:
mari: Quick sync — we need a small backlog ticket to overhaul the GPU fleet Grafana dashboard. Current panels are too noisy and we don't have clear SLO/alert alignment for provisioned capacity. Thinking: utilization (p95/p50), memory headroom, per-GPU thermals, power draw, plus a summary card for 'safe-to-schedule' capacity per AZ.

jason: +1. can you list exact panels you want? I can spin up a branch with JSON model.

mari: Rough wishlist — concise so we can iterate: 1) Cluster-level p50/p95 GPU utilization over 1h/24h 2) Per-instance per-gpu memory used vs total (show headroom in GB) 3) Thermal trend (°C) with thresholds (warn 85, crit 95) 4) Power draw (W) trend and 1m/5m avg 5) 'Safe-to-schedule' card: available gpus = count(gpu) - reserved - gpus with recent (<5m) spike >90% utilization 6) Alert tuning notes + links to runbook.

vikram: For metrics we should use the DCGM exporter: dcgm_gpu_utilization, dcgm_fb_used_bytes, dcgm_fb_total_bytes, dcgm_gpu_temp, dcgm_power_draw. Example PromQL for memory headroom per gpu: 
```
(dcgm_fb_total_bytes - dcgm_fb_used_bytes) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024
```
We should also rate-limit panels that query per-gpu across thousands of GPUs. Use a rollup job that exports per-node aggregates for dashboard summaries.

nate: I can add an aggregated recording rule: `gpu:mem_headroom_gb:sum_by_node` so panels don't hit Prom directly. Also suggests adding a panel for nodes with >1 GPU stuck at high mem usage for >10m (possible leak). Alert idea: page if mem_headroom_gb_by_node < 2GB for 5m AND avg_gpu_utilization_by_node > 85% for 5m.

mari: Sounds good — for SLOs team wants an ops-facing SLO: "Schedule success" — target 99.5% of scheduling requests complete without fallback within 1m. We can approximate with: fraction of requests that were routed to fallback due to full capacity. Put that metric in dashboard header with a small sparkline.

jason: Regarding thermals and power, Grafana alerting tends to flip during scheduled maintenance (fans test). Can we add an annotation panel tied to the maintenance calendar or suppression windows?

infra-bot: maintenance:scheduled window on 2025-07-14 02:00-04:00 UTC created by ops-scheduler — tag: gpu-firmware-update.

mari: Yes — add annotation links and default silence windows for that dashboard. Also add a note in the dashboard description: "Do not page during `gpu-firmware-update` maintenance unless crit threshold exceeded for 30m."

vikram: Small UX ask: use color-blind friendly palette and keep per-AZ filters top-left (region, cluster, instance type). We should predefine template variables: $__region, $__cluster, $__instance_type, $__gpu_id.

nate: For alert tuning, propose two alerts: 1) infra-warning (no page): sustained node-level avg_utilization > 88% for 15m OR mem_headroom_gb < 4GB for 10m — notify #eng-infra 2) infra-critical (page): sustained avg_utilization > 92% AND mem_headroom_gb < 2GB for 5m — page oncall. Keep cooldown 30m.

mari: Agreed. Also add one durability alert: >20% of GPUs in an AZ reporting temp >95C in 10m -> page, possible HW issue.

jason: I'll open a PR with dashboard JSON and a preview link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/preview/xyz (will post when ready). Plan: land recording rules + dashboard together so queries use recordings.

mari: who wants the PR review? tagging @jason and @vikram for panels + promql review. @nate for alert rules.

vikram: I can review panels early tomorrow.

nate: I'll validate alert noise with last 3 months of telemetry — will post suggestions.

jason: TODOs: 1) create recording rules (nate) 2) build dashboard JSON + template vars (me) 3) add annotations and maintenance suppression (mari/ops) 4) review & merge (vikram/nate) — will target next Tuesday for rollout to staging.

mari: perfect. small note: when you push to staging, enable "test alert routing" so we can verify silences and escalation.

ops-bot: deploy:dashboard gpu-fleet-v2 staging started by jason at 2025-07-10T16:12:10Z — status: in_progress

jason: pushed staging preview: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/preview/xyz — sharing in #eng-infra so folks can click through. Feedback welcome, focus on noise reduction. :eyes:

nate: saw preview — queries look efficient, but a couple panels still do per-gpu SELECT across all nodes, I'll post exact lines in PR comments.

mari: thanks everyone. We'll iterate after the staging run. If we still see flapping alerts, we'll drop infra-warning to longer windows rather than change thresholds.

jason: closing loop — I created the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-grafana/pulls/342 — contains dashboard JSON + recording rules + docs link to runbook. Review tags: @vikram @nate @mari.

vikram: reviewing now.

nate: adding alert noise analysis to PR comment.

mari: nice. moving to done for planning.
